activity_summary: You looked back at the board as you went. The penny loaf was still in the scale, with the weights beside it. The pie dish was empty. The light was the ordinary light of a hot Sunday, and no one was posing in it.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once from the door, and did not go back in.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: Mentioned in The loaf left on the scale

facets.activity: Looked back at the loaf still in the scale
